item.title: Humility in government needs some practice closer to home
item.description: HeraldNet.com HeraldNet.com - Everett and Snohomish County news from The Daily Herald in Everett, Washington Thanks to The Herald for publishing Stanwood Mayor Sid Roberts’ piece on the vanishing virtue of humility. (“Forum: We’ll never get to ‘Great Again” without a humble spirit,” The Herald, Jan. 17). I really appreciate Roberts’ eloquent illumination of humility as an essential component of ethical and moral leadership. Humility in government needs some practice closer to home Wire Service

item.title: Is there property tax help for seniors? Yes.
item.description: HeraldNet.com HeraldNet.com - Everett and Snohomish County news from The Daily Herald in Everett, Washington As a senior citizen living in Everett, it is very difficult to vote yes on propositions when you are living on a fixed income, and your taxes and house payment go up regularly on a property you have lived in for many years. Is there property tax help for seniors? Yes. Wire Service
